claims.statement: Observed PC step reads the old carrier, writes W/Z, and performs final poststate readmission; the event operand is a fresh committed C/W/Z reconstruction. This is stage wiring, not native autonomous execution.

The reviewed full-feedback anchor with evolving W/Z has source obstruction and support discrimination; no-split and W/Z reset controls retain that obstruction. Target carrier policy and restoration are separate successor claims.

On the exact decorated 2+2 carrier domain the selected sign-faithful relational bridge lift preserves c_target=c_source and has an inverse, Frobenius isometry and signed-coordinate covariance. Its five-dimensional event image is not the seven-dimensional target ball; Z need not be PSD.

The fixed PC-3 full causal chain uses the fresh source-only allocation 33615/65536 and selected lossless lift, independently admits both target roles, and proves exact-real signed-domain return/asymptotics with W/Z evolving. Two executed target beats per role are not a long trajectory.

The reviewed PC-4 combined paired-domain positive-parameter/fixed-tau variable-request theorem gives uniform obstruction, signed-domain invariance and transfer-entry/return/asymptotics conditional on a resolved admitted source event; its research reference covers the quadratic subclass, independent stage oracle, both-role lifecycle/replay and finite represented C/W/Z errors with measured charge drift.
